artipoppe-zeitgeist-baby-carrier: Carries weight for hours into toddlerhood; bulky, hot and pricey.
babybjorn-baby-carrier-mini: Quick for newborns and easy alone; back strain on longer wears.
babyletto-hudson-3-in-1-convertible-crib: Solid, easy to assemble and reused for a second baby or toddler bed.
britax-poplar: Easy install, fits small back seats and rear-faces for longer.
britax-poplar-s: Fits small cars with front-seat room; legroom tight in a hatchback.
bugaboo-butterfly-2: One-hand fold for cars and planes; small wheels catch on tracks.
bugaboo-fox-5-renew: Sturdy and smooth on snow and trails, with an adjustable handle.
bugaboo-giraffe: Easy to adjust and clean, still used by toddlers; outgrown for one.
chicco-fit360: Rotating seat makes loading easy; it eats front legroom.
chicco-keyfit-35: Easy to install and reused for a second child; heavy as baby grows.
comotomo-baby-bottle: Few parts and easy to clean; some babies refused it.
cybex-gazelle-s: Glides on grass and trails with big storage; the fold can stick.
doona-car-seat-stroller: Car seat to stroller in seconds for travel; heavy, little storage.
ergobaby-embrace: Quick to put on for newborns; outgrown in months for lack of support.
ergobaby-evolve-3-in-1-bouncer: Hands-free breaks that grow with baby; some babies lose interest.
ergobaby-omni-classic: Comfortable well past babyhood; newborns need an insert.
eufy-baby-monitor-e21: Clear picture, reliable app and good battery; one unit overheated.
evenflo-shyft-dualride: Detachable wheels and a plush seat; a couple find it heavy.
graco-extend2fit-3-in-1: Keeps tall kids rear-facing longer and fits smaller cars.
graco-turn2me-3-in-1: Rotating seat eases buckling; it only rotates rear-facing.
ikea-antilop: Cheap, light and wipes clean; legs stick out and the tray is stiff.
infant-optics-dxr-8: Simple monitor with no app or subscription; drops at a distance.
lansinoh-baby-bottles: Breastfed babies took these over others; the flow is fast for some.
medela-harmony-manual-breast-pump: Compact, quiet and portable; empties faster than electric for some.
medela-sonata-smart: Strong, reliable and rechargeable; a couple find it bulky.
momcozy-air-1: Comfortable, discreet wearable with good output; best on the go.
momcozy-m5: Suction rivals a Spectra; one couldn't keep up back at work.
momcozy-s12-pro: Strong suction like a Spectra; motors failed within months.
momcozy-s9-pro: Handy and easy to clean; leaks, weak pull or early failure.
momcozy-v1-pro: Quiet on-the-go pump that empties well; not for exclusive use.
nanit-pro: Reliable app and breathing band; the subscription and price irk.
nuna-mixx-next: Big wheels handle gravel and cobbles; heavy and bulky for some.
nuna-pipa-rx: Light, easy to install and fits many strollers; poor small-baby fit.
nuna-triv-next: Light, easy fold that fits the car; small basket, rougher ride.
nuna-trvl: Light travel stroller that takes hard use; rough on bumpy sidewalks.
nuna-trvl-lx: Light, compact one-hand fold; it won't fit an overhead bin.
owlet-dream-sock: Eased many parents' anxiety; others got frequent false alarms.
solly-baby-wrap: Cozy for newborns; tricky to wrap and hot as baby grows.
spectra-s1-plus: Rechargeable with suction many prefer to wearables; heavy.
stokke-clikk: Easy to clean and light for travel; small tray, legs trip people.
stokke-limas-carrier: Adjustable fit and easy buckle; uncomfortable near 25 lbs for one.
uppababy-cruz-v2: Sturdy on rough ground with a big basket; heavy and bulky.
uppababy-mesa-v2: Easy to carry and click in, with a good insert; some babies balk.
uppababy-minu-v2: Light, quick fold for flyers; small basket, two hands to open.
uppababy-vista-v2: Smooth on snow and cobbles with a big basket; bulky in the trunk.
